ModMetaData.name: IsoRim Waylith - Kiiro Pack
ModMetaData.author: Peren.
ModMetaData.description:
Kiiro in 3D for IsoRim Waylith. Kiiro colonists are drawn as 3D figures in IsoRim's 3D view. Own body and head, with IsoRim's eyes. 3D hair styles, ahoge and cat ears; the ears take the skin colour and show above hats. A 3D tail that follows the body. Works with IsoRim's "Keep as paper" setting. Needs IsoRim Waylith with Api 25 or newer. Also a working example for modders making alien packs: XML and models only, source on GitHub (peren717/IsoRimWaylith-KiiroPack).
让 Kiiro 在 IsoRim Waylith 里变成 3D。 Kiiro 殖民者在 IsoRim 的 3D 视角里显示为 3D 小人。 专属的身体和头部，使用 IsoRim 的眼睛。 3D 发型、呆毛和猫耳；猫耳随肤色，戴帽子时露在帽子外面。 跟随身体的 3D 尾巴。 支持 IsoRim 的「保持纸片人」设置。需要 Api 25 或更新的 IsoRim Waylith。 也是给模组作者的异种族包范例：只有 XML 和模型，源文件在 GitHub（peren717/IsoRimWaylith-KiiroPack）。
